uistudio.evidence: UI Studio library probe record: https://github.com/mitsevox/nflstreet2/pull/7#issuecomment-5945092269 . ProDG 3.9.3 -O2 reproduces neighbouring functions 0x8021A020 and 0x8021C654 exactly; -O1, -Os and -fno-schedule-insns2 change both. -O3 is excluded by inference (it inlines same-file callees the target keeps as calls); -fno-strength-reduce changes 0x8021C654; -ffloat-store changes 0x8021CA54; -G0 changes 0x8021D880 and -G 16 changes 0x8021CA54 (default -G 8 fits). Not discriminated: -fno-schedule-insns and ProDG 3.5-3.9.3. Library scope rests on the target call graph and the shared error callback 0x803EBF30, with related-build file order.

game_cpp.evidence: evidence.tsv compiler row game_cpp: ProDG 3.9.3 cc1plus -O2 -fno-weak reproduces every instruction of the module units 0x8008BB30-0x8008BCF0 and 0x8008B974-0x8008BB30. -O1, -O3, -Os, -fno-schedule-insns, -fno-schedule-insns2, -G0, -fexceptions and -frtti change the output; without -fno-weak the class functions and vtable move to linkonce sections, while the target keeps the destructor 0x8008BC68 inside the contiguous .text run and the vtable in rodata; -fvtable-thunks changes the vtable layout. -ffast-math: evidence.tsv compiler row 0x800034A0-0x801AA640 (game_cpp). Every floating-point compare in game code 0x800034A0-0x801AA640 branches in the ordered form -ffast-math emits; none uses the unordered form ProDG emits without it (cror+bns, or ble/bge after fcmpu). Every earlier game_cpp unit compiles to an identical native object with or without the flag. Open item: the flag turns division by a constant into a reciprocal multiply, while fn_801470F0 divides by the literal 35.0f at 0x80147440 and 0x801474AC; see that row.

engine_c.evidence: evidence.tsv compiler rows 0x80227F14-0x802288F8 and 0x802288F8-0x80228E44 (engine_c): ProDG 3.9.3 cc1 -O2 (default -G 8) reproduces every instruction and data byte of both units; -O1, -O3, -Os and -G0 change them. Same flags as the uistudio profile; a separate profile because uistudio's scope evidence and source root are the UI Studio library, and these units include SDK headers that need include/libc.
